title: Matt Stefanik (Founder, Vinshield) — 'Ries literally laid out the exact framework for what I've always wanted'
summary: Matt Stefanik, founder of Vinshield, posts a substantive LinkedIn reflection pairing Incorruptible with Theo Baker's How to Rule the World: one diagnoses how good companies go bad, the other shows the business-as-usual machine that perpetuates it. Says he's applying Ries's framework directly to his live capital raise for Vinshield to build it incorruptible from the start.
blockquote: So I'm super grateful and fired up to have found such perfect confirmation as well as detailed advice as I move forward with raising capital for Vinshield. Ries literally laid out the exact framework for what I've always wanted with every company I launch, buy, and build - to build it incorruptible from the start, as well as ensuring my vision and mission stay in tact long after I'm gone.
